evidence: Both volcanoes not erupting at image time: Kilauea ADVISORY/YELLOW paused with deflation, next fountain forecast Sep 7-13; Mauna Loa NORMAL/GREEN with only deep seismicity. No active vog source. [E1]
No FIRMS fire clusters in box around plume on 2026-09-04; only 85 pixels of Kilauea-summit volcanic thermal (summit glow, not wildfire). No smoke source to explain streak. [E6]

Mask is 95% ocean (land_frac 0.049) southwest of Hawaii Island, 185 km long thin curved pale gray-white arc over clear-ocean area. Morphology, color and oceanic setting favor cirrus/high cloud over vog/smoke. [E4, E3]

Wind-based NE upwind end lies 76 km from Kilauea and 45 km from Mauna Loa, but actually tracked source end is the SW tip 235 km from Kilauea and 201 km from Mauna Loa, far offshore. Plume does not trail from either vent. [E8, E5]

Measured drift toward 104 deg at 4.9 km/h with poor fit R2 0.16 disagrees with 10-m wind blowing toward ~213 deg (from 33 deg at centroid) by ~109 deg, and by ~155 deg vs wind toward ~259 deg (from 79 deg at SW end). Low-level vog transport story fails; mismatch is expected if feature is high cirrus decoupled from surface flow, but disagreement lowers confidence. [E2, E5, E7]

evidence_cited.text: Both volcanoes not erupting at image time: Kilauea ADVISORY/YELLOW paused with deflation, next fountain forecast Sep 7-13; Mauna Loa NORMAL/GREEN with only deep seismicity. No active vog source.
No FIRMS fire clusters in box around plume on 2026-09-04; only 85 pixels of Kilauea-summit volcanic thermal (summit glow, not wildfire). No smoke source to explain streak.

Mask is 95% ocean (land_frac 0.049) southwest of Hawaii Island, 185 km long thin curved pale gray-white arc over clear-ocean area. Morphology, color and oceanic setting favor cirrus/high cloud over vog/smoke.

Wind-based NE upwind end lies 76 km from Kilauea and 45 km from Mauna Loa, but actually tracked source end is the SW tip 235 km from Kilauea and 201 km from Mauna Loa, far offshore. Plume does not trail from either vent.

Measured drift toward 104 deg at 4.9 km/h with poor fit R2 0.16 disagrees with 10-m wind blowing toward ~213 deg (from 33 deg at centroid) by ~109 deg, and by ~155 deg vs wind toward ~259 deg (from 79 deg at SW end). Low-level vog transport story fails; mismatch is expected if feature is high cirrus decoupled from surface flow, but disagreement lowers confidence.

classify.caveats: Single very-faint thin streak; SAM confidence modest and motion fit poor (R2 0.16), so direction is weak. 10-m wind is a poor proxy for high cirrus motion. No speciation (SO2/aerosol) or upper-level winds used; faint vog admixture or contrail cannot be fully excluded.

kilauea.activity_summary: Kīlauea volcano is not erupting; the summit eruption in Halemaʻumaʻu is paused. The summit is currently in a deflationary step since yesterday morning. A forecast window of September 7-13 is likely for the next fountain episode.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts increased in August, while the summit region showed no other signs of deformation. Mauna Loa had an increase in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 87 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the August reporting period, after 57 in July. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
